notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only sources are Forest Lookouts' Idaho index entries, which give the agency and legal location and nothing else, plus Mapcarta's summit elevation (5,669 ft, 1,728 m), which is map data for the peak and not a lookout height; elevation_m on the tower record could take 1728 but it is not the structure. No source I read says a lookout was built, staffed, removed or stands here. firelookout.org's Idaho Valley County list (checked) and idahofirelookouts.com's West Central category (checked) have no Fletcher Butte entry. The Boise NF brochure described by idahoaclimbingguide.com lists five unmanned lookouts, none named Fletcher Butte; the brochure itself was not read. Trails Offroad (paywalled) and Trailforks (403) were not cited. The story is about 120 words, at the floor, because the evidence does not support more; the Mapcarta location lines are the only additions beyond the listing and the elevation.
